test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Six friends P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting at a circular table facing the centre. S is sitting third to the left of T. R is not sitting between T and U. S is not the immediate neighbour of R. Q is seated second to the right of T and U is sitting second to the left of T. Who is sitting between U and Q?
solution:
Arranging them according to the given information,

S is sitting third to the left of T. Q is seated second to the right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aeedb7d072ca0b40d279dde24dd0a6ec10d84d0c851a8f2c608af39a88ef1c9a.png] 

R is not sitting between T and U. S is not the immediate neighbour of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f83ed1878ffa9720f14bb51f649346de287eefb4589aac197fc0f56ba096db3.png] 

‘S’ is sitting between U and Q.

Hence, “S” is the correct answer.
